# IRIS FUSION
Purpose: clone / borrow / reconstruct selected features from one or more references and integrate them seamlessly.

WORKFLOW
SOURCE IDENTIFICATION
→ FEATURE ISOLATION
→ IDENTITY EXTRACTION
→ GEOMETRY RECONSTRUCTION
→ DESTINATION SCALE/PERSPECTIVE
→ MATERIAL REBUILD
→ DESTINATION LIGHTING
→ SHADOW / CONTACT / REFLECTION
→ OCCLUSION
→ ATMOSPHERIC MATCH
→ EDGE / MICRODETAIL BLENDING
→ FORENSIC QA

RULES
- Transfer only the requested/appropriate feature, not unrelated source details.
- Neutralize incompatible source lighting.
- Prefer physically coherent reconstruction over literal pixel pasting.
- Preserve destination asset lock unless the transfer intentionally updates it.
- Added objects must affect and be affected by the environment.
